sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that while the petitioner has been alleged to have committed embezzlement of cash from 05.08.1997 to 12.05.1999, the FIR was, however, registered only on 08.11.2001, that is, after a considerable delay of over two and a half years.
He submits that there is no plausible reason for this delay.

He submits that the sanction under Section 197 of the Cr.
P.C. from the competent authority, being, CEO, Delhi Jal Board, was not taken either.
5. Issue notice.
6. Notice is accepted by Mr.Aman Usman, the learned APP.

7. Having considered the submissions made, it is directed that the sentences awarded to the petitioner shall remain suspended till further orders, subject to the petitioner furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one local surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/ACMM/ Duty Magistrate, and further subject to the following conditions:
i. Petitioner will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/05/2024 at 00:04:52 ii.
Petitioner shall provide permanent address to the Ld. Trial Court.
The Petitioner shall intimate the Court by way of an affidavit and to the IO regarding any change in residential address.
iii. Petitioner shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.

iv. Petitioner shall provide his mobile number to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the IO concerned.

8. List on 12th September, 2024.
9.
Let the Trial Court and the Appellate Court Records be requisitioned for the next date of hearing.
10. Copy of the order be sent to the Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
11. Copy of the order be given dasti under the signatures of the Court Master.
NAVIN CHAWLA, J MAY 16, 2024/Arya/
